hero.title: The trust layer food trade has been missing
hero.subtitle: Madar isn't another online store — it's the layer the deal, the document, and the data move through, across the Gulf food supply chain.

story.title: Why Madar
story.body: For decades, Saudi Arabia's food wholesale trade has run on personal relationships and phone calls, with no shared record of pricing or terms. Buyers have no reliable way to confirm a supplier's licensing or food-safety record before ordering, and neither side has the order or performance data needed to plan with confidence. Madar was founded in Riyadh to replace these fragmented channels with a single, transparent, and reliable platform.

mission.title: Mission
mission.body: To connect verified manufacturers with the Kingdom's leading buyers through a single marketplace that removes uncertainty from wholesale trade — replacing informal deals with verified partners, manual guesswork with real-time data, and scattered relationships with one dependable channel.

vision.title: Vision
vision.body: To become the trusted infrastructure that powers every food transaction between manufacturer and buyer across Saudi Arabia and the wider region.

whyNow.title: Why now
whyNow.body: The Gulf food supply chain is expanding fast, while its trade channels still lack real digitization or a shared trust layer. Madar is building that layer from day one — for verification, not just for growth.

hero.title: A complete system for trustworthy wholesale trade

items.title: Verification & trust
items.desc: Every supplier passes verification covering commercial registration, food-safety certification (SFDA), and production capacity, before any of their products appear in the market. Ratings at the item and batch level — not just the supplier — reflect real accuracy and delivery reliability.
